text: Robert James Kenneth Peston (born 25 April 1960) is a British journalist. In 2005 his biography of Gordon Brown, Brown's Britain was published. In 2013, How Do We Fix This Mess?: The Economic Price of Having it All, and the Route to Lasting Prosperity was published. On 17 October 2013 he was made the Economics Editor for BBC News.
title: Robert Peston

author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
text: Robert James "Bob" Keeshan (June 27, 1927 – January 23, 2004) was an American television producer and actor. He is known for his role as the title character of the children's television program Captain Kangaroo. It became an icon for millions of people during its 30-year run from 1955 to 1984. Keeshan also played the original "Clarabell the Clown" on the Howdy Doody television program. Keeshan died in Windsor, Vermont from a heart attack. He was aged 76.
title: Bob Keeshan

author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
text: Howard Markel (born April 23, 1960) is an American physician, author, professor and a medical historian. Markel has written many books, such as Quarantine!, When Germs Travel, The Kelloggs, and others. He has given advice to governments about how to manage epidemics and diseases. In January 2020, he wrote an article for the New York Times criticizing the Chinese government's actions about the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic.
title: Howard Markel

text: Yvan Darsigny is a retired weightlifter from Canada. Yvan competed at the 1984 Summer Olympics and the 1992 Summer Olympics. He was born on 2 March 1966.
title: Yvan Darsigny

text: "Your Child" is a 2000 song by Mary J. Blige and is the fourth and final single from her fourth studio album Mary. It went to number 1 on the Billboard Dance Club Songs charts.
title: Your Child

author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
text: Acetaldehyde (systematic name ethanal) is an organic compound with the chemical formula CH3COH. It is one of the simplest aldehydes. It is important in both biology and thechemical industry. Acetaldehyde is made by plants. It is found in coffee, bread and fruit. The human body makes acetaldehyde when it breaks down ethanol. Acetaldehyde in the body is a major cause of hangover symptoms.
title: Acetaldehyde

author: Simple English Wikipedia contributors
text: Propylene glycol, also called 1,2-propanediol or α-propylene glycol, is an organic compound. The chemical formula of propylene glycol is CH3CH(OH)CH2OH. Propylene glycol is used as a food additive, an ingredient in polymers, and a solvent. Mixtures of propylene glycol and water are used as antifreeze. It is mixed with glycerin to make liquid for e-cigarettes. It is the second-simplest vicinal diol, a type of chemical where two hydroxy groups are attached to a pair of neighbouring carbon atoms. It is a positional isomer of trimethylene glycol, which is sometimes also called β-propylene glycol.
title: Propylene glycol
